_comment: The null-props widget card's static strings (D44): a six-language table baked into the widget binary, keyed by the device locale the widget process itself reads via the __expoWidgetDeviceLocale global the runtime patch installs. The title stays the brand Athan. The owner verifies every string in the confidence build (D42).
